principles.name: Uniform chiral physics
principles.statement: The Standard Model, with its measured CP violation, holds throughout N. The CKM Jarlskog invariant is J = (3.12 +0.13/-0.12) x 10^-5 (PDG 2024), nonzero at about 25 sigma.

principles.name: Finite primordial thermodynamics
principles.statement: A free quantum field in thermal equilibrium at the Big Bang had a finite partition function at every temperature. Theorem C' proves this is equivalent to each of: finite spatial volume; closed space; and Hartle-Hawking no-boundary creation (space is the boundary of a compact 4-geometry).

principles.name: Local Copernican principle
principles.statement: Every local observable of the primordial quantum field has the same expectation value at every point of space. This constrains only what an observer can measure in an arbitrarily small neighbourhood of themselves. It is strictly weaker than asking the whole two-point function to be statistically homogeneous.

principles.name: Primordial supersymmetry
principles.statement: At creation the state preserves an untwisted global supersymmetry: some supercharge has a covariantly constant spinor parameter on Sigma.
